search.noSourceLead: The app does not ship with any depot sources. Paste a URL pointing at a folder that follows the layout branches/<appid>/<files> (containing .lua, .manifest and optional key.vdf files). GitHub repos and archive.org/view_archive.php URLs are auto-detected; any plain HTTPS base URL also works.
search.inputPlaceholder: Search by name or App ID…
search.noResults: No manifests found for this App ID in any configured depot source. Add or enable more sources in Settings.
search.invalidAppId: Please enter a valid App ID

patchOnly.lead: Already have the game files? Point this at the folder and run only the emulator step: DLL swap, Steamless and gbe_fork config. Nothing is downloaded.
patchOnly.folderPlaceholder: Path to the folder with the game files…
patchOnly.folderHint: Pick the folder that holds the game executable and its Steam API library. Subfolders are scanned too.
patchOnly.appIdPlaceholder: Search by name or App ID…
patchOnly.appIdHint: Required — the emulator writes it to steam_appid.txt. Type a game name to look it up.
patchOnly.scanning: Scanning folder for Steam API libraries…
patchOnly.errorAppId: Enter a numeric App ID, or pick a game from the suggestions.
patchOnly.errorNoApiFiles: No Steam API library (steam_api.dll, steam_api64.dll or libsteam_api.so) was found in this folder. Pick the folder the game executable lives in.

select.depotSearchPlaceholder: Search by Depot ID, name, role…
select.downloadLocationHint: Default: Documents/SteamDownloads — Game files will be saved in a subfolder here
select.manifestHubHint: Optional fallback if direct Steam fetch fails. Get a key at manifesthub2.filegear-sg.me
select.manifestHubRequired: You set a custom manifest ID — a ManifestHub API key is required to fetch it.
select.manifestHubAfterFailure: Direct Steam fetch failed for at least one depot. Paste a ManifestHub API key here and retry to use it as fallback.
select.updateNotice: Update mode: the download goes into {path}. Only changed files are downloaded, files removed from the game are deleted and depots that are already up to date are skipped.
select.repairNotice: Check mode: every file in {path} is compared with the installed version. Only damaged or missing parts are downloaded again, nothing is updated.
select.autoSelectTitle: Picked like Steam would: {count} of {total} depots
select.noKeyHint: This depot has no decryption key in the file or source, so it cannot be downloaded.

progress.cancelledCleanup: Download cancelled and files are being cleaned up.
progress.nativeAlphaBody: This is experimental. If anything fails, please copy the console errors below and open an issue on GitHub — or turn the native engine off in Settings to fall back to DepotDownloaderMod.

progress.checkingBranch: Checking the depot sources for App {appId}…

progress.noLongerRunning: The download is no longer running.

shortcut.title: Create Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Create desktop or start menu shortcuts to launch the downloaded game.
shortcut.exeHint: Auto-detected game executable. Click browse or select from detected files below.
shortcut.noLocation: Please select at least one place for the shortcut.

cancel.title: Cancel Download?
cancel.body: Are you sure you want to cancel? All downloaded files for this App ID will be permanently deleted.
cancel.bodyKeep: Are you sure you want to cancel? Already downloaded files will be kept on disk so the download can resume later.

close.title: Close Application?
close.body: A download is in progress! Closing will cancel it and you may lose progress. Close anyway?

telemetry.title: Help improve the app?
telemetry.lead: We'd like to collect anonymous usage statistics so we know which features to invest in.
telemetry.collectItem3: A random install ID (not tied to you)
telemetry.collectItem4: Why a download or an emulator patch failed — which step and what kind of error, from a fixed list of labels
telemetry.neverItem1: Game IDs, depot IDs, file names
telemetry.neverItem4: Your manifest source URLs — only the kind of source, never the address
telemetry.hint: Events are end-to-end encrypted with a public key embedded in the app — only the maintainer's server can decrypt them. You can change your choice anytime in Settings → Privacy & diagnostics.

update.title: Update Available
update.systemText: This build is installed by your package manager. Update with:

removeDefaultSource.title: Remove default source?
removeDefaultSource.body: This is a source that was installed with the app. Search by App ID will stop working until you add your own source. You can always re-add it later.

historyRemove.title: Remove entry?
historyRemove.body: This removes the entry from your history. Downloaded files stay on disk.
historyRemove.bodyResumable: This download is resumable. Removing the entry will also delete the partially downloaded files on disk and you won't be able to resume it.

historyClear.title: Clear all history?
historyClear.body: This removes all entries from your history. Downloaded files stay on disk.
historyClear.bodyShort: This removes all entries from your history.
historyClear.resumableWarning: {count} resumable download still has partial files on disk. You will not be able to resume it after this.
historyClear.deleteFilesLabel: Also delete the partial files from disk

emuRevert.title: Revert emulator patch?
emuRevert.body: This restores the original Steam API library and removes the emulator files that were placed next to it. Your gbe_fork configuration files stay on disk but are no longer used.
emuRevert.scope: This affects the {count} already-patched file(s) in this folder. Files that are not patched are left untouched.

emuDownload.title: Download the gbe_fork emulator?
emuDownload.body: Patching needs the emulator files from the gbe_fork project on GitHub. They are downloaded once and cached locally for future patches.

folderMissing.title: Folder not found
folderMissing.body: The download folder no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.

shutdown.title: Shutting Down
shutdown.body: The download has finished. The PC will shut down in {seconds} seconds.
shutdown.failed: The PC could not be shut down: {message}

followup.title: Continue Where You Left Off?
followup.body: The download of “{name}” finished before the PC shut down. You can now catch up on the steps after it: shortcuts, Steam library and emulator.

resume.title: Resume Download
resume.body: Resume continues where the download stopped and only checks the last pieces before that point. Check Everything reads all files that were already downloaded and compares them, which can take several minutes for large games.

space.title: Not Enough Disk Space
space.body: This download needs about {needed}, but only {free} is free at {path}. Free up space or pick another download location.

launch.title: Which File Starts the Game?
launch.body: Pick the program file of the game. SMD remembers it for the next start.

emulator.title: Apply Emulator Patch
emulator.description: Replace the game's Steam API library with the gbe_fork emulator so the game can run without the Steam client.
emulator.variantRegularHint: Stable build, recommended for most games.
emulator.noFiles: No Steam API libraries were found in the download folder.
emulator.applyCancelled: Patch cancelled before the emulator download.
emulator.avBlockedTitle: It looks like your antivirus is blocking gbe_fork.
emulator.avBlockedHint: Windows Defender (or another antivirus) quarantined the emulator archive during extraction. Allow it in your antivirus (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history), then retry. This can need administrator rights; if you cannot change antivirus settings on this PC, the emulator cannot be used here.
emulator.achievementWatcherHint: Tip: Achievement Watcher shows a notification when you unlock an achievement in an emulated game (Windows). The original is no longer developed; the fork by Darktakayanagi is still maintained.
emulator.hintDownload: The emulator tools could not be downloaded from GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again later, GitHub limits how often it can be asked. The standalone ZIP version already contains these files and works without this download.
emulator.hintPermission: Windows did not allow writing to the game folder. This happens when the game is in a protected place such as C:\Program Files. Move the game folder to a place you own, for example Documents or the Desktop, and try again.
emulator.hintAntivirusFile: Your antivirus removed or blocked an emulator file. Allow it in your antivirus (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history) and try again. This can need administrator rights; if you cannot change antivirus settings on this PC, the emulator cannot be used here.
emulator.settingsHint: Unset values keep the gbe_fork defaults. You can change these later from the History tab.
emulator.settingsHintStandalone: Unset values keep the gbe_fork defaults. This folder is not in your download history, so reopen this tab to change them later.

fields.accountNameHint: Name the game sees from the Steam API.
fields.accountSteamIdHint: 64-bit Steam ID. Leave empty for the gbe_fork default.
fields.languageHint: Steam language code, e.g. english, german, french.
fields.ipCountryHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. US, DE, FR).
fields.localSavePathHint: Override where the emulator stores save data. Empty = gbe_fork default.
fields.savesFolderNameHint: Per-game subfolder name for save data.
fields.offlineHint: Force the emulator to act as if Steam is offline.
fields.steamDeckHint: Pretend the game runs on a Steam Deck.
fields.disableNetworkingHint: Block all network features (matchmaking, friends, P2P).
fields.disableLanOnlyHint: Allow connections beyond the local network.
fields.recordPlaytimeHint: Have the emulator track in-game playtime.
fields.achievementsBypassHint: Auto-unlock achievements as the game requests them.
fields.forceSteamhttpSuccessHint: Make all Steam HTTP requests appear to succeed.
fields.freeWeekendHint: Tell the game it is running during a free weekend.
fields.enableExperimentalOverlayHint: In-game ImGui overlay with achievement popups.
fields.overlayAlwaysShowFpsHint: Pin the FPS counter to the overlay.
fields.overlayAlwaysShowPlaytimeHint: Pin the session timer to the overlay.
fields.keyComboHint: Key combination to toggle the overlay (e.g. ShiftTab, CtrlShiftO).

emulator.editDescription: Change gbe_fork emulator settings for a previously patched game. Saving updates the steam_settings files in place.
emulator.editNoPatches: No patched Steam API files found in this game's folder.
emulator.drmDescription: These executables are protected by Steam DRM (SteamStub). They won't run with the emulator until the DRM is removed.
emulator.drmRemoving: Removing DRM — this may take a minute…
emulator.drmRemoveSuccess: DRM removed from {count} file(s). Original kept as .drm.bak.
emulator.drmMonoHint: DRM removal on Linux/macOS requires `mono` (e.g. `pacman -S mono`, `apt install mono-runtime`, `brew install mono`).
emulator.dlcMergeHint: Multiple depot folders found. Many games expect DLC content next to the main game files.
emulator.dlcMergeHintDetail: Found {count} depot folder(s) that should be merged into the main game depot ({main}) so the game finds them at the expected path.
emulator.dlcMergeSkippedNote: These depots will be left alone (different platform or unknown role):
emulator.dlcMergeDone: Merged {count} DLC depot(s) into the main game folder.
emulator.bypassHint: Installs a version.dll next to the game that intercepts Steam-API integrity checks. Enable if the game refuses to launch with gbe_fork. Windows games only.
emulator.bypassLinuxNote: Not available — this bypass relies on Windows DLL search-order hijacking and the detected files are Linux-only. Linux games with gbe_fork rarely need this anyway.
emulator.bypassSuccess: Steam API bypass installed for {count} target(s).
emulator.patchedNoticeAll: This folder is already patched. The settings below were read from its existing configuration — change them and press Save Settings, or use Revert Patch to restore the original Steam API libraries.
emulator.patchedNoticeSome: {patched} of {total} detected files are already patched and stay unticked. Tick one to re-apply the current emulator build to it, or use Save Settings to update the gbe_fork configuration of every patched file without touching the libraries.
emulator.settingsHintPatched: These values were read from the steam_settings files in this folder. Clearing a field removes that setting when you save.
emulator.settingsReadError: Could not read the existing emulator settings: {message}. Saving is disabled so the current configuration is not overwritten.
emulator.applyNoSelection: No files selected — tick at least one Steam API file.
emulator.dlcActivated: {count} DLC(s) marked as owned for gbe_fork, matching your download.
emulator.dlcNone: No DLC was chosen for this download, so gbe_fork reports none as owned.

gameData.label: Game data for gbe_fork
gameData.hint: Writes what gbe_fork needs into steam_settings: languages, depots, branches, achievements with icons, leaderboards, inventory items, the controller layout and cloud save folders. With a Steam Web API key also the stats and all achievements.
gameData.nothing: No game data found for this game.
gameData.failed: Game data could not be written: {message}
gameData.needsKey: No achievements found. With a Steam Web API key you also get stats and achievements Steam does not list publicly.
gameData.keyRejected: Steam did not accept the Web API key. Check it at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey.
gameData.webApiFailed: Steam Web API did not answer, achievements were left out.
gameData.mediaHint: Artwork, screenshots and inventory icons go into a steam_media folder in the game folder. The game does not need them.
gameData.appInfoFailed: Steam did not return the app info, so languages, branches, the controller layout and cloud save folders are missing.
gameData.inventoryFailed: The inventory list could not be downloaded.
gameData.leaderboardsFailed: The leaderboards could not be loaded from the Steam Community.
gameData.controllerFailed: The game has a Steam Input layout, but it could not be downloaded.
gameData.controllerBuild: The controller layout only works with the Windows experimental build or on Linux.

steamLibrary.title: Add to Steam Library
steamLibrary.description: Add this game to your Steam library as a non-Steam shortcut with full grid art. The game appears like any other Steam game.
steamLibrary.notDetected: No Steam installation with a signed-in user was found.
steamLibrary.exeHint: Auto-detected executable. Click Browse or pick from detected files.

steamLibrary.steamRunning: Steam is running. Steam has to be closed while the game is added, otherwise Steam removes the entry again when it exits. Close Steam and try again, or let the app do it.
steamLibrary.restartHint: Steam has to be closed while the entry is added, otherwise Steam overwrites it.
steamLibrary.protonNote: Tip: After Steam restarts, right-click the entry → Properties → Compatibility and enable Proton to run this Windows game on Linux.
steamLibrary.windowsToggleHint: Creates a non-Steam shortcut with grid art so the game appears in your Steam library too.
steamLibrary.chooseFolderTitle: Choose the Steam folder (the one with steam.exe)

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoUpdateToggle: Automatically check for updates on startup
settings.autoUpdateHint: Checks GitHub for a new version at startup and offers to install it.
settings.languageHint: Switching the language requires restarting the app.
settings.ddExtraArgsHint: Only used by the DepotDownloaderMod engine.
settings.maxRetriesHint: Extra attempts per depot when the connection drops.
settings.chunkConcurrencyHint: Lower it if downloads make the system lag.
settings.speedLimitHint: Also applies to a running download. 100 Mbit/s is about 12 MB/s.
settings.proxyHint: For every download and update. http://host:port or socks5://host:port, user:password@ if needed. Empty uses the system proxy.
settings.depotSourcesHint: Folders in the branches/<appid>/ layout with keys and manifests, asked in this order.
settings.hubcapApiKeyHint: Adds Hubcap as a source when it has the game.
settings.ryuuApiKeyHint: Adds Ryuu as a source when it has the game.
settings.cancelKeepFilesHint: A cancelled download can then be resumed where it stopped.
settings.nativeDownloaderHint: Loads manifests and files straight from Steam. Off uses the old DepotDownloaderMod engine.
settings.notificationSoundToggle: Play a sound when downloads complete

settings.telemetryToggle: Send anonymous usage events to help improve the app
settings.telemetryHint: Encrypted, without game IDs, paths or account data. Also reports crashes so bugs get fixed. Privacy details.
settings.debugInfoHint: Paste it into bug reports. With statistics on, the diagnostic ID lets the maintainer find the errors your app reported.
settings.speedLimitExample: empty = unlimited, e.g. 10 MB/s or 100 Mbit/s
settings.speedLimitInvalid: Invalid speed limit. Examples: 10 MB/s or 100 Mbit/s.
settings.autoSelectDepots: Like Steam: pick the depots and put them into one game folder

settings.targetPlatformHint: Auto uses this system. Without a Linux build the Windows version is picked and runs with Proton.

settings.steamPathHint: Needed to add games to Steam and start them through it. Leave it empty to find Steam on its own.
settings.autoStartDownloadHint: You only pick the game, the download starts 5 seconds later.
settings.includeDlcHint: The emulator step marks the DLC as owned for gbe_fork.
settings.steamWebApiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Steam Web API key…
settings.steamWebApiKeyHint: Optional, for achievements and stats in the emulator step. Get a free key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. It stays on this PC and is only sent to Steam.
